title: Quantization of Preprojective Algebras and the Type A Rational Cherednik Algebra
summary: For the Jordan quiver, we construct a radial quantum trace morphism from the quantum preprojective algebra to the algebra of invariant differential operators on the Cartan subalgebra. Its classical limit recovers the classical trace morphism associated with the commuting quotient, and we prove that both the quantum and classical trace morphisms are surjective. We further relate noncommutative quantizations of the Jordan preprojective algebra to the spherical rational Cherednik algebra of type A.
